description: This file declares internal, inline/templated components of the Abseil Split API, including classes like ConvertibleToStringView, SplitIterator, and Splitter, which are used for string splitting operations. It contains internal implementation details and utility templates for string splitting functionality.

classes.name: ConvertibleToStringView
classes.description: A class implicitly constructible from various string types, excluding rvalue strings, used to facilitate safe string conversions.

classes.name: SplitIterator
classes.description: An iterator class that enumerates parts of a string split by a Splitter, used internally for iteration over split substrings.

classes.name: Splitter
classes.description: A class that implements string splitting logic, providing range-based iteration and implicit conversions to various container types.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Returns the original text to be split.

methods.name: delimiter
methods.description: Returns the delimiter used for splitting.

methods.name: predicate
methods.description: Returns the predicate used for filtering split parts.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the beginning of the split range.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the end of the split range.
